Input_002
Positioning
Adam Ho, I.S.P., is the independent studio practice of Adam Ho, a designer raised and based in Queens, New York. As a 1graphic designer and 2image maker, he places emphasis on delving into the nuances of 3protean, 4generative and 5intuitive brand identities, as well as showcasing those findings through exploratory interaction design and emerging media. His motivation for the practice is to 6research the interplay of art and design, taking notes and chords from different canons of the past, the present, and the interpretation of the future. This can be observed through his project, Liquidities, where creative expression and the ability to experiment with different approaches of art and technologies form a 7symbiotic relationship with his personal and commercial work.
          8Make it a bit different.

Input_006
Profile
Before forming Adam Ho, I.S.P., Adam had previously worked in-house on design teams at Cash App and Zendesk. He also collaborated with design-forward brands such as Square, Messenger, Coinbase, Postmates, Medium, and Airbnb.

His primary focus is on creating large-scale visual brand identities and interaction design for emerging technology companies.
